page.title: Win / loss analysis
page.subtitle: Why Vireek wins and loses deals. Vireek staff only; this data is never shown to customers.
page.loadFailedBody: Check your connection and try again.
page.forbiddenBody: Only Vireek staff can view or change win/loss records.

summary.title: Summary
summary.empty: No deals recorded yet. Add the first one with the form below.
summary.winRateNote: Win rate = won ÷ (won + lost). “No decision” is excluded.
summary.lowSample: Fewer than {{count}} decided deals: treat as anecdote, not signal.
summary.reasonNote: A deal is counted once under each of its reasons, so reason rows do not add up to the total.

form.dealNameHelp: Company or opportunity name. No personal names or contact details.
form.competitorHelp: Who or what won it. Use “status quo” if no vendor was chosen. Required for lost deals.
form.reasonsHelp: Pick the reasons the buyer gave, not the reasons we assume.
form.notesHelp: Facts and short buyer quotes. No personal data, no contact details, no secrets.
form.saveFailed: Could not save the deal. Please try again.
form.saveInvalid: The server rejected this deal. Check the fields and try again.
form.saveForbidden: You do not have permission to change win/loss records.

errors.competitorRequiredForLoss: Enter who the deal was lost to (or “status quo”).
errors.dateInvalid: Enter a valid date from 2020 onward.
errors.dateFuture: The close date cannot be in the future.
errors.valueInvalid: Enter a valid amount, for example 1200 or 1200.50.
